scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:dev -w @mdiscovershop/api" "npm run dev -w @mdiscovershop/web" "npm run dev -w @mdiscovershop/admin"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n api-tsc,api,web,admin -c blue,cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @mdiscovershop/api" "npx nodemon --watch apps/api/dist --delay 1 --exec node apps/api/dist/main.js" "npm run dev -w @mdiscovershop/web" "npm run dev -w @mdiscovershop/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mdiscovershop/shared && npm run build -w @mdiscovershop/api && npm run build -w @mdiscovershop/web && npm run build -w @mdiscovershop/admin
